Lists all Montgomery census tracts with zero listed pharmacies by left-joining every tract to its pre-aggregated pharmacy count and filtering to counts of zero, ordered with zero counts first and tract name breaking ties.
sql:
WITH tract_pharmacy AS (
  SELECT geoid, n AS pharmacy_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_78c1c7'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp = 'all'
)
SELECT t.name,
       COALESCE(p.pharmacy_count, 0) AS pharmacy_count,
       t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN tract_pharmacy p ON t.geoid = p.geoid
WHERE COALESCE(p.pharmacy_count, 0) = 0
ORDER BY pharmacy_count ASC NULLS LAST, t.name ASC
